final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT tr.ordertypedist AS mix, AVG(sf.optvolrt) AS avg_optvolrt, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS sf JOIN transactionrecord AS tr ON sf.transref COLLATE BINARY = tr.transreg COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY tr.ordertypedist), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_optvolrt) AS overall_avg FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT s1.mix, s1.avg_optvolrt, s1.record_count, s1.avg_optvolrt - s2.overall_avg AS difference FROM step1 AS s1 CROSS JOIN step2 AS s2 WHERE s2.overall_avg IS NOT NULL AND s1.avg_optvolrt > s2.overall_avg) SELECT AVG(avg_optvolrt), AVG(record_count), AVG(difference) FROM step3
